# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by src/docs.py from sql/schema.yml and the warehouse. Edit the source and rerun the pipeline, not this file. -->

Every table and column in the reporting layers of the Kelip Bank warehouse: the star schema (`marts`) and the KPI layer (`kpi`). Types and row counts come from the warehouse after a full run. The staging layer is described in [the data sources](02_data_sources.md), and how the tables join is drawn in [the ER diagram](er_diagram.md). All data is synthetic.

## The marts schema

The star schema. Dimensions describe who and what; facts record what happened.

<a id="martsdim_date"></a>

### marts.dim_date

Calendar for the reporting window, 1 Sep 2024 to 31 Aug 2026.

- **Grain:** One row per day
- **Primary key:** `date_day`
- **Rows:** 730

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date_day` | DATE | The date |
| `year` | BIGINT | Calendar year |
| `month` | BIGINT | Month number, 1 to 12 |
| `quarter` | BIGINT | Calendar quarter, 1 to 4 |
| `year_month` | VARCHAR | Year and month as text, e.g. 2025-03 |
| `month_start` | DATE | First day of the month |
| `month_end` | DATE | Last day of the month |
| `fiscal_year` | VARCHAR | Financial year (Kelip Bank's financial year is the calendar year), e.g. FY2025 |
| `day_of_week` | BIGINT | Day of week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday |
| `day_name` | VARCHAR | Short day name, e.g. Mon |
| `is_month_end` | BOOLEAN | True on the last day of the month |
| `is_weekend` | BOOLEAN | True on Saturday and Sunday |

<a id="martsdim_channel"></a>

### marts.dim_channel

Acquisition channels.

- **Grain:** One row per channel
- **Primary key:** `channel`
- **Rows:** 6

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `channel` | VARCHAR | Channel key, e.g. tiktok |
| `channel_name` | VARCHAR | Channel name for reports |
| `channel_group` | VARCHAR | organic, paid_media or bonus_scheme |
| `is_paid` | BOOLEAN | True if the channel costs money |
| `cost_model` | VARCHAR | How the channel is paid for |
| `sort_order` | BIGINT | Display order |

<a id="martsdim_product"></a>

### marts.dim_product

Products. CASA is the savings account; FD are fixed deposits; CARD is the debit card; PF is personal financing.

- **Grain:** One row per product
- **Primary key:** `product_code`
- **Rows:** 6

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_code` | VARCHAR | Product key, e.g. FD-12M |
| `product_name` | VARCHAR | Product name for reports |
| `product_family` | VARCHAR | CASA, FD, CARD or PF |
| `tenor_months` | INTEGER | Term in months for fixed deposits; empty otherwise |
| `is_deposit` | BOOLEAN | True for savings and fixed deposits |

<a id="martsdim_customer"></a>

### marts.dim_customer

Customers, with how they were acquired and whether they activated their debit card.

- **Grain:** One row per customer
- **Primary key:** `customer_id`
- **Rows:** 32,574
- **Joins to:** `acquisition_channel` references `marts.dim_channel.channel`
- **Joins to:** `applicant_id` references `marts.fct_onboarding_funnel.applicant_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Customer identifier from core banking |
| `applicant_id` | VARCHAR | The app sign-up that became this customer |
| `open_date` | DATE | Date the account opened (Malaysia time) |
| `cohort_month` | DATE | Month the account opened |
| `acquisition_channel` | VARCHAR | Channel the applicant came from |
| `ekyc_flow` | VARCHAR | eKYC flow the applicant saw, control or guided |
| `device_os` | VARCHAR | android or ios, from the first app event |
| `state` | VARCHAR | Malaysian state or federal territory, standardised |
| `employment_type` | VARCHAR | salaried, self_employed, student, retired or not_working |
| `income_band` | VARCHAR | Declared monthly income band in RM |
| `risk_rating` | VARCHAR | Anti-money-laundering risk rating, low, medium or high |
| `age_at_open` | BIGINT | Age in years when the account opened |
| `age_band` | VARCHAR | Age group at opening |
| `savings_account_id` | VARCHAR | The customer's savings (CASA) account |
| `card_id` | VARCHAR | The customer's debit card, if issued |
| `has_debit_card` | BOOLEAN | True if a debit card was issued |
| `card_activation_date` | DATE | Date the debit card was activated |
| `card_activated_30d` | BOOLEAN | True if the card was activated within 30 days of opening |
| `fraud_flag_date` | DATE | Date fraud monitoring flagged the account, if it did |
| `fraud_flagged_30d` | BOOLEAN | True if flagged within 30 days of opening (the eKYC test's guardrail) |
| `customer_status` | VARCHAR | ACTIVE or CLOSED |
| `closed_date` | DATE | Date the savings account closed, if it did |

<a id="martsdim_account"></a>

### marts.dim_account

Accounts held at Kelip Bank. Savings, fixed deposits and debit cards.

- **Grain:** One row per account
- **Primary key:** `account_id`
- **Rows:** 59,937
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`
- **Joins to:** `product_code` references `marts.dim_product.product_code`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | VARCHAR | Account identifier (SA savings, FD fixed deposit, DC debit card) |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Account holder |
| `product_code` | VARCHAR | Product |
| `product_name` | VARCHAR | Product name |
| `product_family` | VARCHAR | CASA, FD or CARD |
| `open_date` | DATE | Date opened (for a card, the date issued) |
| `close_date` | DATE | Date closed or matured |
| `account_status` | VARCHAR | ACTIVE, CLOSED, MATURED or NOT_ACTIVATED (cards) |
| `fd_rate_pct` | DECIMAL(6,2) | Fixed deposit interest rate, % a year |
| `fd_principal` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Amount placed in the fixed deposit (RM) |
| `tenor_months` | INTEGER | Fixed deposit term in months |
| `maturity_date` | DATE | Fixed deposit maturity date |
| `campaign_code` | VARCHAR | Promotion the deposit was placed under, e.g. RAYA25 |
| `is_promo_fd` | BOOLEAN | True for Raya promotion fixed deposits |
| `rollover_of_account_id` | VARCHAR | The fixed deposit this one rolled over from |
| `linked_account_id` | VARCHAR | The savings account a card or fixed deposit is linked to |
| `card_activation_date` | DATE | Date a debit card was activated |

<a id="martsfct_onboarding_funnel"></a>

### marts.fct_onboarding_funnel

Accumulating snapshot of the sign-up journey, with the time each step was reached.

- **Grain:** One row per applicant
- **Primary key:** `applicant_id`
- **Rows:** 64,588
- **Joins to:** `acquisition_channel` references `marts.dim_channel.channel`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `applicant_id` | VARCHAR | Applicant identifier from the app |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Customer created if the account opened |
| `acquisition_channel` | VARCHAR | Channel the applicant came from |
| `device_os` | VARCHAR | android or ios |
| `ekyc_flow` | VARCHAR | eKYC flow shown, control or guided |
| `is_in_ekyc_test` | BOOLEAN | True if the applicant started during the eKYC A/B test (1 Feb to 30 Apr 2026) |
| `start_month` | DATE | Month sign-up started |
| `signup_started_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 1, sign-up started (Malaysia time) |
| `phone_verified_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 2, phone number verified |
| `id_scanned_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 3, MyKad scanned |
| `liveness_passed_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 4, selfie liveness check passed |
| `ekyc_approved_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 5, eKYC approved (identity and name screening) |
| `account_opened_ts` | TIMESTAMP | Step 6, account opened |
| `liveness_failures` | BIGINT | Failed selfie attempts |
| `is_ekyc_rejected` | BOOLEAN | True if eKYC rejected the applicant |
| `furthest_step_no` | INTEGER | Furthest step reached, 1 to 6 |
| `is_opened` | BOOLEAN | True if the account opened |
| `went_to_manual_review` | BOOLEAN | True if eKYC approval took over an hour (manual review) |
| `hours_to_open` | DECIMAL(10,2) | Hours from sign-up start to account opening |

<a id="martsfct_ledger_postings"></a>

### marts.fct_ledger_postings

Every posting to savings and fixed deposit accounts. Credits are positive, debits negative.

- **Grain:** One row per posting
- **Primary key:** `posting_id`
- **Rows:** 2,965,311
- **Joins to:** `account_id` references `marts.dim_account.account_id`
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`
- **Joins to:** `product_code` references `marts.dim_product.product_code`
- **Joins to:** `posting_date` references `marts.dim_date.date_day`
- **Joins to:** `auth_id` references `marts.fct_card_authorisations.auth_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `posting_id` | VARCHAR | Posting identifier from the posting engine |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR | Account posted to |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Account holder |
| `product_code` | VARCHAR | Product of the account |
| `product_family` | VARCHAR | CASA or FD |
| `posting_ts_myt` | TIMESTAMP | Posting time, Malaysia time |
| `posting_date` | DATE | Posting date, Malaysia time (this decides the month) |
| `posting_month` | DATE | First day of the posting month |
| `amount` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Signed amount in RM, credit positive |
| `direction` | VARCHAR | CR or DR |
| `txn_type` | VARCHAR | Standard transaction type, e.g. duitnow_out, card_purchase, fd_placement |
| `is_customer_initiated` | BOOLEAN | True for transactions the customer made (transfers out, bills, card purchases, FD placements) |
| `channel` | VARCHAR | Payment rail, e.g. DUITNOW, CARD, JOMPAY |
| `reference` | VARCHAR | Linked record (card authorisation, fixed deposit or loan) |
| `auth_id` | VARCHAR | Card authorisation settled by this posting |
| `loan_id` | VARCHAR | Loan disbursed or repaid by this posting |

<a id="martsfct_card_authorisations"></a>

### marts.fct_card_authorisations

Debit card authorisations from the card processor, with settlement timing.

- **Grain:** One row per authorisation
- **Primary key:** `auth_id`
- **Rows:** 1,157,070
- **Joins to:** `card_id` references `marts.dim_account.account_id`
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`
- **Joins to:** `auth_date` references `marts.dim_date.date_day`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `auth_id` | VARCHAR | Authorisation identifier from the processor |
| `card_id` | VARCHAR | Card used |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Cardholder |
| `auth_ts_myt` | TIMESTAMP | Authorisation time, Malaysia time |
| `auth_date` | DATE | Authorisation date |
| `auth_month` | DATE | First day of the authorisation month |
| `amount` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Amount in RM |
| `mcc` | INTEGER | Merchant category code |
| `merchant_category` | VARCHAR | Merchant category, from the MCC |
| `category_group` | VARCHAR | Broader merchant group |
| `entry_mode` | VARCHAR | CONTACTLESS, CHIP or ECOM |
| `response_code` | VARCHAR | Processor response, 00 approved, 51 insufficient funds, 55 wrong PIN, 59 suspected fraud |
| `response_description` | VARCHAR | Response code in words |
| `status` | VARCHAR | Final status, APPROVED, DECLINED or REVERSED |
| `was_approved` | BOOLEAN | True if the authorisation was approved at the time (response 00) |
| `is_approved_final` | BOOLEAN | True if approved and not later reversed |
| `settlement_date` | DATE | Processor settlement date; empty if not settled |
| `settlement_month` | DATE | First day of the settlement month |
| `settlement_lag_days` | BIGINT | Days from authorisation to settlement |
| `is_late_settlement` | BOOLEAN | True if settlement took more than three days |

<a id="martsfct_account_balances_monthly"></a>

### marts.fct_account_balances_monthly

Periodic snapshot of deposit balances at each month end, with the interest accrued in the month.

- **Grain:** One row per savings or fixed deposit account per month
- **Primary key:** `account_id`, `month_end_date`
- **Rows:** 362,720
- **Joins to:** `account_id` references `marts.dim_account.account_id`
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`
- **Joins to:** `month_end_date` references `marts.dim_date.date_day`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | VARCHAR | Account |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Account holder |
| `product_code` | VARCHAR | Product |
| `product_family` | VARCHAR | CASA or FD |
| `is_promo_fd` | BOOLEAN | True for Raya promotion fixed deposits |
| `month_start` | DATE | First day of the month |
| `month_end_date` | DATE | Last day of the month |
| `balance` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Month-end balance reported by core banking (RM) |
| `prior_balance` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Previous month-end balance (zero in the opening month) |
| `average_balance` | DECIMAL(18,3) | Average of the opening and closing balance |
| `interest_rate_pct` | DOUBLE | Rate that applied, % a year |
| `interest_accrued` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Interest cost accrued on the average balance for the month (RM) |

<a id="martsfct_loan_status_monthly"></a>

### marts.fct_loan_status_monthly

Periodic snapshot of personal financing at each month end, with delinquency.

- **Grain:** One row per loan per month on the books
- **Primary key:** `loan_id`, `month_end_date`
- **Rows:** 51,246
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`
- **Joins to:** `month_end_date` references `marts.dim_date.date_day`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | VARCHAR | Loan identifier |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Borrower |
| `month_end_date` | DATE | Snapshot date (month end) |
| `month_start` | DATE | First day of the month |
| `vintage_month` | DATE | Month the loan was disbursed |
| `credit_policy` | VARCHAR | Credit policy that approved it, v1, v2 or v3 |
| `policy_name` | VARCHAR | Credit policy name |
| `risk_grade` | VARCHAR | Risk grade at approval, A (best) to D |
| `principal` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Amount disbursed (RM) |
| `interest_rate_pct` | DECIMAL(6,2) | Effective interest rate, % a year |
| `tenor_months` | INTEGER | Term in months |
| `months_on_book` | BIGINT | Months since disbursement (0 in the disbursement month) |
| `outstanding_principal` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Principal outstanding at month end (RM) |
| `instalments_due` | INTEGER | Instalments due so far |
| `instalments_paid` | INTEGER | Instalments paid so far |
| `instalments_in_arrears` | INTEGER | Instalments due but not paid |
| `days_past_due` | INTEGER | Days since the oldest unpaid instalment fell due |
| `dpd_bucket` | VARCHAR | Current, 1-29, 30-59, 60-90, 90+, Settled or Written off |
| `loan_status` | VARCHAR | ACTIVE, SETTLED or WRITTEN_OFF |
| `is_on_book` | BOOLEAN | True while the loan is active |
| `is_30plus` | BOOLEAN | True if 30 or more days past due |
| `is_impaired` | BOOLEAN | True if more than 90 days past due |
| `ever_30plus` | BOOLEAN | True if the loan has been 30+ days past due at any month end so far |
| `written_off_amount` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Principal written off this month (RM) |
| `interest_income_accrued` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Interest earned this month on a performing loan (RM) |

<a id="martsfct_marketing_spend"></a>

### marts.fct_marketing_spend

Marketing spend from the hand-kept sheet, reshaped to one row per line per month.

- **Grain:** One row per sheet line per month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`, `line_label`
- **Rows:** 192
- **Joins to:** `channel` references `marts.dim_channel.channel`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | First day of the month |
| `channel` | VARCHAR | Channel paid for; brand and deposit_promo lines are not acquisition |
| `line_label` | VARCHAR | Line label as typed in the sheet |
| `is_acquisition` | BOOLEAN | True if the spend acquires customers |
| `spend` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Spend in RM; empty while an invoice is missing |
| `is_missing` | BOOLEAN | True if the sheet says n/a (invoice not received) |

<a id="martsfct_customer_monthly"></a>

### marts.fct_customer_monthly

Periodic snapshot of each customer's behaviour in each month since they opened.

- **Grain:** One row per customer per month while their account is open
- **Primary key:** `customer_id`, `month_start`
- **Rows:** 334,469
- **Joins to:** `customer_id` references `marts.dim_customer.customer_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Customer |
| `cohort_month` | DATE | Month the account opened |
| `month_start` | DATE | First day of the month |
| `months_since_open` | BIGINT | Months since the opening month (0 in the opening month) |
| `customer_txns` | BIGINT | Transactions the customer made themselves |
| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | True if the customer made at least one transaction themselves |
| `card_txns` | BIGINT | Card purchases posted |
| `card_spend` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Card purchases posted (RM) |
| `transfers_and_bills_out` | DECIMAL(38,2) | DuitNow transfers out and bill payments (RM) |
| `salary_in` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Salary credited (RM) |
| `transfers_in` | DECIMAL(38,2) | DuitNow transfers in (RM) |
| `casa_balance` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Savings balance at month end (RM) |
| `fd_balance` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Fixed deposit balance at month end (RM) |

## The kpi schema

KPI tables built from the marts, one SQL file per KPI family, plus the scorecard.

<a id="kpigrowth_monthly"></a>

### kpi.growth_monthly

Growth and onboarding KPIs by month.

- **Grain:** One row per month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`
- **Rows:** 24

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | Month |
| `applications_started` | BIGINT | K01 applicants who started sign-up |
| `new_customers` | BIGINT | K02 accounts opened |
| `onboarding_conversion` | DOUBLE | K03 share of the month's applicants who opened an account |
| `ekyc_completion_rate` | DOUBLE | K04 share of applicants who scanned their MyKad and passed liveness |
| `acquisition_spend` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Marketing spend on acquisition (RM); empty while an invoice is missing |
| `cac` | DOUBLE | K05 acquisition spend per new customer (RM) |
| `spend_incomplete` | BOOLEAN | True if an acquisition invoice is missing this month |
| `m3_active_rate` | DOUBLE | K06 share of customers opened three months earlier who were active this month |

<a id="kpichannel_monthly"></a>

### kpi.channel_monthly

Acquisition economics by channel and cohort month.

- **Grain:** One row per channel per cohort month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`, `channel`
- **Rows:** 144

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | Cohort month (month the accounts opened) |
| `channel` | VARCHAR | Channel key |
| `channel_name` | VARCHAR | Channel name |
| `is_paid` | BOOLEAN | True if the channel costs money |
| `applications_started` | BIGINT | Applicants who started sign-up in the month |
| `new_customers` | BIGINT | Accounts opened in the month |
| `spend` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Channel spend in the month (RM) |
| `cost_per_new_customer` | DOUBLE | Spend per account opened (RM) |
| `m3_active_customers` | BIGINT | Of the month's new customers, those active in their third month |
| `m3_active_rate` | DOUBLE | Share of new customers active in their third month |
| `cost_per_m3_active_customer` | DOUBLE | Spend per customer still active in month three (RM) |

<a id="kpiengagement_monthly"></a>

### kpi.engagement_monthly

Engagement KPIs by month.

- **Grain:** One row per month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`
- **Rows:** 24

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | Month |
| `open_customers` | BIGINT | Customers with an open account at month end |
| `monthly_active_customers` | BIGINT | K07 customers who made at least one transaction themselves |
| `active_customer_rate` | DOUBLE | K08 active customers / open customers |
| `txns_per_active_customer` | DOUBLE | K09 customer-initiated transactions per active customer |

<a id="kpicards_monthly"></a>

### kpi.cards_monthly

Debit card KPIs by month.

- **Grain:** One row per month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`
- **Rows:** 24

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | Month |
| `card_spend` | DECIMAL(38,2) | K11 card purchases posted to the ledger (RM) |
| `card_purchases` | BIGINT | Card purchases posted |
| `authorisations` | BIGINT | Authorisation attempts |
| `approved` | BIGINT | Attempts approved (response 00) |
| `card_approval_rate` | DOUBLE | K12 approved / attempts |
| `declined_insufficient_funds` | BIGINT | Declined for insufficient funds (51) |
| `declined_wrong_pin` | BIGINT | Declined for a wrong PIN (55) |
| `declined_suspected_fraud` | BIGINT | Declined as suspected fraud (59) |
| `active_cardholders` | BIGINT | Customers with at least one approved purchase |
| `card_activation_30d` | DOUBLE | K10 share of the month's new cardholders who activated within 30 days; blank until every customer in the cohort has had 30 days |

<a id="kpifd_maturity_outcomes"></a>

### kpi.fd_maturity_outcomes

What happened to each matured fixed deposit, for K16.

- **Grain:** One row per matured fixed deposit
- **Primary key:** `account_id`
- **Rows:** 2,023

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | VARCHAR | Fixed deposit account |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Depositor |
| `is_promo_fd` | BOOLEAN | True for Raya promotion deposits |
| `maturity_date` | DATE | Maturity date |
| `maturity_month` | DATE | First day of the maturity month |
| `matured_amount` | DECIMAL(18,2) | Principal plus interest paid out at maturity (RM) |
| `rolled_over` | BOOLEAN | True if rolled into a new fixed deposit |
| `left_within_30d` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Money transferred out of the bank within 30 days of maturity (RM) |
| `retained_30d` | DECIMAL(38,2) | Money still with the bank 30 days after maturity (RM) |
| `window_complete` | BOOLEAN | True once 30 days have passed within the data |

Personal financing KPIs by month.

Every catalog KPI in one long table, for the dashboard and the Excel pack.

<a id="kpiscorecard"></a>

### kpi.scorecard

The six scorecard KPIs against plan with a red, amber or green status.

- **Grain:** One row per scorecard KPI per month
- **Primary key:** `month_start`, `kpi_id`
- **Rows:** 140

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | Month |
| `kpi_id` | VARCHAR | KPI identifier |
| `kpi_name` | VARCHAR | KPI name |
| `unit` | VARCHAR | count, pct or rm |
| `direction` | VARCHAR | higher or lower is better |
| `owner` | VARCHAR | Accountable owner |
| `actual` | DOUBLE | Value this month |
| `prior_month` | DOUBLE | Value last month |
| `plan` | DOUBLE | Plan for the month |
| `pct_of_plan` | DOUBLE | actual / plan |
| `variance_to_plan` | DOUBLE | actual - plan |
| `amber_tolerance` | DOUBLE | How far from plan still counts as amber |
| `status` | VARCHAR | GREEN, AMBER or RED |
| `status_label` | VARCHAR | On plan, Watch or Off plan (the status in words) |
| `status_rank` | INTEGER | 1 green, 2 amber, 3 red (for sorting) |
| `change_vs_prior_month` | VARCHAR | better, worse or flat, allowing for direction |
